tools.name: find_tool
tools.description: Matches a website-checking or creation need against the jwatte.com catalog using weighted words, related terms and phrase matches. Returns up to 10 matching tools with titles, descriptions, source links and takes_url flags indicating support for browser run links.

tools.name: get_audit_link
tools.description: Creates a browser run link for a catalog tool that supports website addresses. Opening the link fills in the address and starts that tool, which may fetch the target through the site hosting function and configured proxies. The MCP call itself never fetches or audits the target and returns no audit

tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Searches the jwatte.com article catalog by keyword and returns up to 25 matches ranked by relevance, each with a title, publication date, source link and summary.

tools.name: get_book_info
tools.description: Catalog details for one of J.A. Watte's six books by slug: title, subtitle, page count, format, listed price, a short factual summary, Amazon link and companion website. Slugs: w2trap, condotrap, resaletrap, 97launch, 20agency, 100network. Prices are catalog values, not a live retailer lookup.

tools.name: recommend_book
tools.description: Matches a reading topic against subject phrases and related-word rules for J.A. Watte's six-book catalog. A match returns a title, a topic-based reason, and links. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_audit_link" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.detail: Tool "list_audit_tools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
